title: qr-code-styling README — options surface (width/height/type/data/image/margin(px)/qrOptions{typeNumber,mode,errorCorrectionLevel}/imageOptions{hideBackgroundDots,imageSize(0.4, 'not recommended over 0.5'),margin,crossOrigin}/dotsOptions{type: rounded|dots|classy|classy-rounded|square|extra-rounded}/cornersSquareOptions/cornersDotOptions/backgroundOptions; gradient {type:'linear'|'radial', rotation, colorStops}; SVG output caveat: embedded images saved as URLs 'some svg applications will not render' (verified 2026-09-13)

qr-code-styling source — append() does direct container.appendChild (NO shadow DOM); update() clears container and re-appends; getRawData(extension) → Promise<Blob|Buffer|null> (Blob in browser); applyExtension(fn) exists; types at lib/index.d.ts; runtime dep: qrcode-generator ^1.4.4

qr-code-styling releases — v1.9.2 published 2025-04-11 (xlink:href), v1.9.1 2025-01-10, v1.9.0 2025-01-06; low-maintenance cadence; open issue #321 (2026-06-02): download() always emits JPEG regardless of extension → use getRawData(); open issue #279: flicker on update() re-render (verified 2026-09-13)

Next.js lazy loading (next/dynamic ssr:false) — prescribed mitigation for qr-code-styling's import-time browser-global access ('self is not defined' SSR crash widely reported; secondary-source flagged, mitigation is cheap insurance)
r/webdev (2026) + MDN canvas.toBlob compat — Safari does not encode image/webp and silently falls back to PNG; PNG/JPEG canvas export universal; informs the PNG/JPEG/SVG-only export matrix

ISO/IEC 18004:2024 (QR Code) OBP page — 4-module quiet zone requirement on all sides (corroborated by the-qrcode-generator.com and qrnow.com quiet-zone explainers); qr-code-styling's margin is pixels → quietZonePx = modules × (size / moduleCount)

ZXing wiki Barcode-Contents — Wi-Fi 'WIFI:T:WPA;S:…;P:…;H:true;;' (T ∈ WEP|WPA|WPA2-EAP|nopass; 'Android, iOS 11+' native parse); exact escaping: backslash-escape \ ; , : " ; vCard 3.0 and MECARD forms documented without a reliability ranking; mailto:?subject=&body=; tel:+…; sms:/SMSTO:; geo:lat,lon,alt
ZXing wiki — 'SMSTO:' prefixes 'are seen in the wild but lack an official spec'; basis for deferring SMS payloads out of v1

jsQR — v1.4.0 (2021, frozen, stable), Apache-2.0, zero deps, ~46 KB gzipped (bundlephobia); API jsQR(imageData.data, width, height, { inversionAttempts: 'attemptBoth' }) → null | { data, binaryData, chunks, version, location }; attemptBoth costs ~50% perf; no primary-source claim about styled-code decodability → in-tab verify is the ground truth
ZXing ErrorCorrectionLevel source — L ~7%, M ~15%, Q ~25%, H ~30% codeword recovery, citing ISO/IEC 18004:2006 §6.5.1 (DENSO WAVE qrcode.com confirms M/Q)

Community consensus (labeled as such, no ISO number): logo ≤ ~30% of area with ECC H; contrast heuristic ~3:1 warn threshold; styled dot types low-risk if modules stay in grid cells and finder patterns stay intact
iOS Safari canvas ceiling ≈ 16.7M px — toBlob/toDataURL silently fail above it; 2048×2048 (4.2M px) is safe; do not offer 4096
